question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

GLOBAL : HNRAYI :: HONEST : IQQDQQ :: ITSELF : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

GLOBAL : HNRAYI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fa9adce24b06b3dadfbdd4231b40e0397cbf3fee5026fb99728ab99bd7ad29d.png] 

And,

HONEST : IQQDQQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79952a6ff3061b1aefd7eb5b19a8c955f054a15a928f643378796e925884200b.png] 

Similarly,

ITSELF : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06f908d5608fe0be186a37025709045357944382aad6a7f498ae3cac7fadfcc0.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
